post.description:
Creates an embedded signature request for a template with one or more signers.
If template fields have assigned roles, `signers` must include a signer for each
of those roles. Requires `signers` (array of email, name, and role, in signing
order). Optional `sender` (email and name); when omitted, sender defaults to the
API key organization owner. Optionally accepts a `fields` array to pre-fill
template fields. Use each signer's `recipientSignatureId` with the create signing
URL endpoint to mint embeddable links.

templateId.description: The ID of the template to create a signature request for

signers.description: People who will sign, in signing order. Must cover every role assigned to fields on the template.

role.description: Template signer role assigned to this signer. Required for roles assigned to template fields.

sender.description: Optional. Who is sending the request. When omitted, defaults to the API key organization owner.

testMode.description: Optional flag to mark the signature request as a test. Test mode requests are not counted toward billing

fields.description: Optional array of fields to pre-fill in the template

fieldId.description: The ID of the field in the template

value.description: The value to pre-fill in the field

signatureRequestId.description: The unique identifier of the created signature request

recipientSignatureId.description: Use this ID to create a signing URL for this recipient

400.description: Bad request - missing or invalid parameters (e.g. missing templateId/signers, template missing required role-assigned fields, missing signer for a required role, invalid fieldId)

error.example: Missing signer for role "Client" required by template fields

403.description: Forbidden - client not authorized to create a signature request for this template

error.example: Client not authorized to create a signature request for this template
Template not found for id abc123xyz
Internal server error

post.description:
Creates a signature request for a template with one or more signers and emails each signer a signing link (same delivery path as sharing from the Formable platform).
If template fields have assigned roles, `signers` must include a signer for each of those roles. Requires `signers` (array of email, name, and role, in signing order). Optional `sender` (email and name); when omitted, sender defaults to the API key organization owner. Optionally accepts a `fields` array to pre-fill template fields. You do not need to create signing URLs; Formable emails each signer.

templateId.description: The ID of the template to create a signature request for

signers.description: People who will receive a signing email, in signing order. Must cover every role assigned to fields on the template.

role.description: Template signer role assigned to this signer. Required for roles assigned to template fields.

sender.description: Optional. Who is sending the request. When omitted, defaults to the API key organization owner.

testMode.description: Optional flag to mark the signature request as a test. Test mode requests are not counted toward billing

fields.description: Optional array of fields to pre-fill in the template

fieldId.description: The ID of the field in the template

value.description: The value to pre-fill in the field

200.description: Signature request created successfully and signing emails dispatched

signatureRequestId.description: The unique identifier of the created signature request

recipientSignatureId.description: Per-signer ID for this recipient on the signature request

400.description: Bad request - missing or invalid parameters (e.g. missing templateId/signers, template missing required role-assigned fields, missing signer for a required role, invalid fieldId)

error.example: Missing signer for role "Client" required by template fields

403.description: Forbidden - client not authorized to create a signature request for this template

error.example: Client not authorized to create a signature request for this template
Template not found for id abc123xyz
Internal server error

post.summary: Create a redline URL for a member
post.description:
Generates a redline URL for a specific member email associated with a redline request.
The member must already be part of the redline request. API-created URLs use the
embedded path. If it is not that member's turn, an out-of-turn URL is returned instead.
